title: The Frontiers of Orthodontically Induced Inflammatory Root Resorption: Mechanism, Treatment, and Future Prospects
html: Orthodontically induced inflammatory root resorption (OIIRR) is a frequent complication of orthodontic treatment, featured by sterile inflammatory destruction of root hard tissues, which arises from the crosstalk between biomechanical forces and molecular pathways in the periodontal microenvironment.
